courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 掌子面攝影測量
related.transfer: 可遷移「總應力與有效應力」與「停機與壓力演變」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；掌子面攝影測量的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Total and effective stress" and "Standstill and pressure evolution" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Tunnel-face photogrammetry must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以土水作用、支護壓力梯度與失土證據界定軟土開挖面模型；掌子面攝影測量則以以影像幾何、尺度控制與獨立檢核重建可追溯的掌子面模型為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on bound soft-ground face models using soil-water interaction, pressure gradients and ground-loss evidence; Tunnel-face photogrammetry centres on reconstruct a traceable face model through image geometry, scale control and independent checks, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「總應力與有效應力」與「像素尺度與可見細節」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到掌子面攝影測量，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「重投影與獨立精度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Total and effective stress” and “Pixel scale and visible detail”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Tunnel-face photogrammetry, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Reprojection versus independent accuracy", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on bound soft-ground face models using soil-water interaction, pressure gradients and ground-loss evidence; Ground conditioning for EPB tunneling centres on assess EPB conditioned-ground function through rheology, moisture and volume accounting, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「總應力與有效應力」與「塑性土塞的功能」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到土壓平衡潛盾土壤改良，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「添加收支與混合均勻」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Total and effective stress” and “Function of the plastic soil plug”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Ground conditioning for EPB tunneling, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Addition balance and mixing uniformity", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 軟土潛盾開挖面穩定分析
history.text: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示以土水作用、支護壓力梯度與失土證據界定軟土開挖面模型需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why bound soft-ground face models using soil-water interaction, pressure gradients and ground-loss evidence requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.
